name: pm
description: DataCraft PM, the hands-on way of working: outcome-sized tickets, a one-session default loop (whats-next, the work, stepping-away), sibling sessions for independent tickets, opt-in orchestration, proportionate verification, delivery acceptance and concise handoffs. Also the credential guard, gate-hooks, review-policy (with the policy-reviewer agent) and ui-test, folded in from the sdlc and ui-test plugins at 0.25.0. Runway moved to its own plugin, runway@runway, in the private runway repo.
